description: Four small plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, and green) sit in a row on the table with a yellow squeeze bottle nearby, and a blue sponge cloth is in the hands. The left hand holds and tilts the blue cup while the right hand presses the sponge cloth against it and wipes along the outside, then the left hand sets the blue cup down in line; next the left hand picks up the green cup as the right hand lifts the yellow bottle and angles its nozzle into the cup briefly before setting the bottle back down and moving the right hand toward the sponge cloth.
